comment: zoom-private Android managed-app reference config for MDM (Intune, Knox, Android Enterprise). Zero-prompt rollout: run scripts/provision-android.ps1 on an admin-provisioned device (grants runtime permissions with 'adb install -g', pre-enables Accessibility, whitelists battery, starts the unattended service) or use 'dpm set-device-owner com.betterdesk.client.universal/com.carriez.flutter_hbb.BetterDeskDeviceAdmin' after a factory reset for silent grants. Browser downloads always show Android's one-time 'Download anyway' + Play Protect prompt; MDM/provisioned installs show none.
